rows.currentScript: “gla” is not a word, so it cannot be the answer. “pin” makes “pinch”, which is not how you learn to swim. “tea” makes “teach”, which means help us learn.
rows.whyRewrite: First person: the last sentence says "teach, which means help us learn." — "us" breaks the no-first-person rule. Working is otherwise correct (TEA->TEACH, PIN->PINCH, GLA not a word); reword without "us", e.g. "which means show someone how".
